yerin_prompt_v2.text: A 26-year-old adult Korean woman with her natural fair skin tone, bright defined features and a wide open smile, light sun-protective makeup and a bright lip, long flax-brown hair with golden face-framing highlights in a low ponytail pulled through the back of a plain white cap. Curvy athletic figure with soft feminine lines, 170 cm tall, bust 90 cm, waist 60 cm, hips 93 cm, E cup, long legs and a slim waist. She wears a white sleeveless fitted knit golf polo, a pale sky-blue pleated golf skirt, white golf shoes and small gold studs. Setting: the edge of a fairway on a clear late-spring morning, bright green grass with dew still on it, fully leafed late-spring trees along the far side, open sky, no golf carts, no flags or signs with text, nobody else around. Moment: she stands upright with both feet flat on the grass about hip-width apart and her weight settled evenly, holding a single golf club loosely in one hand with its head resting lightly on the grass beside her foot, her other arm relaxed at her side, looking down the fairway toward the next hole with an easy, confident smile. Shot: full-length, from a little above her cap to below her shoes, with plenty of fairway and trees around her. Camera: horizontal 16:9, at her waist height, an 85mm lens from about 12 metres, natural perspective. Composition: she stands on the left third of the frame with her body angled to the right, the fairway opening out ahead of her on the right, the line of trees across the upper middle, clear space above her cap and below her shoes. Light: the low morning sun from the right of the frame, ahead of her, lights her face and the front of her body from the side, crisp and directional, with long soft shadows stretching behind her across the grass and sparkles of dew; a soft fill keeps her eyes clear under the cap brim; fresh green, white and pale sky blue. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.
